answer: Tenure accrues like an ember that only brightens while it stays lodged in one account; the instant an operator forks it into a sable twin, the stake weight splits and decays, so neither half keeps the original glow. The ledger treats tenure as non-transferable, carving its history into a karst of eroded credit that cannot be remolded into a fresh identity. An attacker buying a new head must rebuild tenure from zero, since splitting never yields two full-strength accounts, only two diminished fragments.
